selection_method: Pinned-model raw-score sign operating point reviewed against the balanced Vietnamese case labels
limitations: The cases are synthetic engineering fixtures, not a production benchmark.
The cutoff is provisional until the provisioned model is calibrated against live Vietnamese retrieval scores.
No factual-confidence or probability interpretation is assigned to the raw score.
